wu: Circle Game: Pass the soft ball around the circle. When the music stops, the child holding the ball answers 'What animal is it?' and the class guesses.
wuAlt: Flashcard Jump: Lay animal flashcards on the floor. Children jump on the card you name and say the word.
Simon Says: Play Simon Says with actions like 'Simon says be a big lion!'
pres: Show flashcards of lion, elephant, monkey, snake. Model 'It is a lion. It is big. It has got a mane. It lives in the jungle.' Ask 'Where does it live?' to check understanding.
presAlt: Story Time: Read 'Walking Through the Jungle' and stop to ask about each animal's home.
Puppet Show: Use animal puppets to ask 'What is it? It is a __.' and 'Where does it live?'
prac: Pair Work: Match animal flashcards to home flashcards (jungle/forest) with the sentence 'It is a __. It lives in the __.' Support with sentence strips.
pracAlt: Board Game: Roll a dice and move. Land on a square, say the animal and its home.
Find Your Partner: Children wear animal pictures and find their home partner by saying 'I live in the __.'
ls: Listen to animal-homes riddles: 'I am big and grey. I have a long nose. I live in the jungle. What am I?' Children point to the correct animal flashcard.
re: Jungle Run: When you call an animal, children run to the 'jungle' corner. When you call 'snake!', they freeze. Checks listening and movement.
prod: Craft: Decorate a 'My Wish for 2027' star. Write 'I wish for __.' and draw a picture. Share wishes with a partner.
rw: Animal Fact Sheet: Trace and copy sentences like 'The lion has got a big mane.' Then write one original fact with 'has got'.
st: Sing 'Happy New Year' with actions. End with the Goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Child describes an animal with 'It is big/small. It has got __.' Class guesses.
Children line up in order of months when called, saying 'January, February...'
Pass a wrapped parcel; when music stops, name an animal and its home.
Child acts an animal, others guess 'Is it a lion?'
Teams race to match animal flashcards to home flashcards.
diff: Fast finishers: Draw a new animal and write two facts with 'has got'.
Support: Use word banks with animal and home words for the fact sheet.
hw: Teach the 4 wild animals and their homes to a family member.
Write your wish on the class poster template at home.
Draw a picture of your favorite wild animal and label it.
tip: Use TTPR (Total Physical Response) for animal actions to engage kinesthetic learners and reinforce vocabulary retention.
